problem_register_binding.summary: Hosted FE 9b0df6622 (with #1118) at 1274x627: an unnamed meeting_action_ticket row in the cited evidence list rendered '會議行動單' as the primary name and then rendered '會議行動單' again in the kind line underneath, before the refId 'facts:meeting_action_ticket:rt-action-16f4b51de06f6629684a6ab4402dbc5a' and '這筆證據沒有記錄名稱。'. #1118 only collapsed the kind · source_class duplicate.

AC1_unnamed_cited_row_shows_kind_label_o.implementation: Extracted citedRowRecordedName(row) in src/management/pages/oversight/_core.tsx and updated EvidenceCitedList row rendering so showKind is true only when the row has a recorded display name (recordedName !== null && displayName !== kindLabel). When a cited row has no recorded name, the name line carries citedKindLabel(t, row.refKind) and the kind line underneath omits kindLabel—rendering either no kind line at all when sourceClassLabel equals kindLabel (or is '—'), or only sourceClassLabel when sourceClassLabel differs from kindLabel. The refId line and the name-missing note remain unchanged, and rows with a recorded name keep their kind line unchanged.
